validation_type: property-based implementation audit (artefacts are read and tested)
note: Each check reads a real artefact produced by this run and tests a property of it. A check whose evidence is missing is FAIL, never PASS.

checks.requirement: LOSO uses exactly the six locked states
checks.evidence: config and executed folds both contain exactly 6 states: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, Ohio

checks.requirement: No train/validation/test observation overlap in any experiment
checks.evidence: all 7 experiments show zero overlap on real county-year IDs

checks.requirement: Calibration observations never overlap test observations
checks.evidence: calibration/test overlap = 0 in all 7 experiments with a calibration partition

checks.requirement: Internal early-stopping split is drawn only from training data
checks.evidence: early-stopping split is disjoint from dev, cal and test in all 6 experiments that use one

checks.requirement: Test labels never used for fitting, selection or calibration
checks.evidence: every stage is bound to a partition disjoint from test: Temporal[feature_selection->train, multicollinearity_pruning->train, county_baseline->train, target_detrending->train, preprocessor_fitting->train, scaler_fitting->train, model_fitting->train, early_stopping->dev, ensemble_weight_selection->dev, conformal_calibration->cal, final_evaluation->test]; LOSO/Illinois[feature_selection->train, scaler_fitting->train, preprocessor_fitting->train, target_detrending->fit_full, model_fitting->train, early_stopping->es_internal, ensemble_weight_selection->dev, conformal_calibration->cal, final_evaluation->test] ...

checks.requirement: Temporal partitions are FIT 1985-2013 / DEV 2014-2015 / CAL 2016-2018 / TEST 2019-2023 with no year in two partitions
checks.evidence: observed year ranges {'fit': (1985, 2013), 'dev': (2014, 2015), 'cal': (2016, 2018), 'test': (2019, 2023)}; each year belongs to exactly one partition

checks.requirement: Feature selection fitted on the FIT partition only
checks.evidence: selection funnel 117 candidates -> 100 consensus -> 93 after multicollinearity pruning -> 94 final; all stages fitted on FIT partition (1985-2013) only, and the provenance ledger binds feature_selection to the train partition

details.sequence: candidates -> 4-method consensus vote (>=2 votes or protected) -> correlation (|r|>0.95) + iterative VIF (>10.0) pruning on FIT only -> + county_baseline -> final modeling feature set

checks.requirement: Scaler fitted on the FIT partition only
checks.evidence: scaler_fitting bound to the train partition in all 7 experiments (Temporal, LOSO/Illinois, LOSO/Indiana, LOSO/Iowa, LOSO/Minnesota, LOSO/Missouri, LOSO/Ohio); scaling_report.json records scaler='n/a'

checks.requirement: Temporal ensemble weight selected on DEV only, and is the DEV argmin
checks.evidence: selection metric = DEV_2014_2015_RMSE; frozen weight 0.85 equals the argmin over 21 candidate weights scored on DEV

checks.requirement: LOSO ensemble weight selected on LOSO DEV only, and is the DEV argmax
checks.evidence: all 66 candidate weights scored on LOSO_DEV_2014_2015; each state's frozen weight is the DEV argmax

checks.requirement: Joint and post-hoc training paths are genuinely different
checks.evidence: joint = 1 stage(s) with quantile gradients reaching the backbone; post-hoc = 2 stages with a frozen backbone; max absolute difference in test point predictions = 1.215924

checks.requirement: Ablation configurations 3, 4 and 5 are mutually distinct
checks.evidence: 2_plus_cdhw vs 3_plus_cqr: PASS (interval head added (post-hoc: the point path is unchanged by design)); 3_plus_cqr vs 4_plus_aci: PASS (static conformal -> ACI (calibration only)); 4_plus_aci vs 5_full_joint: PASS (post-hoc -> joint end-to-end training)

checks.expected_difference: interval head added (post-hoc: the point path is unchanged by design)

checks.requirement: TEST partition untouched until final evaluation
checks.evidence: no pipeline stage other than final_evaluation is bound to the test partition in any experiment; decisions were frozen before the final refit (model_decisions_lock.json status=LOCKED_FINAL_DECISIONS, early_stopping_on_refit=False)

checks.requirement: No artefact claims seven LOSO folds (the protocol has six)
checks.evidence: no stale seven-fold reference found in code or reports; config.LOSO_STATES has 6 states

checks.requirement: Significance testing accounts for temporal/spatial dependence
checks.evidence: O5 primary inference = OLS with cluster-robust (CR1) standard errors clustered by year (5 clusters, effective n = 35 from 2345 rows); O6 Friedman executed = True, block unit = year, k = 6 with q_alpha = 2.85

checks.requirement: SHAP attributions are genuinely computed (no synthetic fallback)
checks.evidence: 4 backbone(s) explained with real SHAP explainers (NeuralCQR: shap.GradientExplainer (mean head), LightGBM: shap.TreeExplainer, CatBoost: shap.TreeExplainer, XGBoost: shap.TreeExplainer); excluded (not fabricated): none; agreement label = strong agreement

checks.requirement: Dataset checksum covers the complete file
Computational benchmark uses warm-up, no-grad, explicit batch sizes and separates inference from end-to-end latency
checks.evidence: device = cuda (Tesla T4), cuda_available = True, warm-up = 10, timed repeats = 50, gradients disabled = True, batch sizes = [1, 32, 256, 2345]; GPU memory method = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated
